verses.en: A revelation of Jesus Christ unto his servant Joseph Smith, Jun., and six elders, as they united their hearts and lifted their voices on high.
verses.sm: O se faaaliga a Iesu Keriso i lana auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma toeaina e toaono, a’o latou tuufaatasi o latou loto ma siitia a’e o latou leo i lugā.

verses.en: Yea, the word of the Lord concerning his church, established in the last days for the restoration of his people, as he has spoken by the mouth of his prophets, and for the gathering of his saints to stand upon Mount Zion, which shall be the city of New Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ioe, o le afioga a le Alii e faatatau i lana ekalesia, ua faatuina i aso e gata ai mo le toefuataiga o ona tagata, e pei ona sa ia fetalaia e ala mai i fofoga o ana perofeta, ma mo le faapotopotoina o lana au paia e tutulai i luga o le Mauga o Siona, lea o le a avea ma aai o Ierusalema Fou.

verses.en: Which city shall be built, beginning at the temple lot, which is appointed by the finger of the Lord, in the western boundaries of the State of Missouri, and dedicated by the hand of Joseph Smith, Jun., and others with whom the Lord was well pleased.
verses.sm: O le aai lea o le a fausia, e amata mai i le fanua o le malumalu, lea ua tofia e le tamatama’iaao o le Alii, i tuaoi i sisifo o le Setete o Misuri, ma ua faapaiaina e le lima o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma isi o e na fiafia tele i ai le Alii.

verses.en: Verily this is the word of the Lord, that the city New Jerusalem shall be built by the gathering of the saints, beginning at this place, even the place of the temple, which temple shall be reared in this generation.
verses.sm: E moni o le afioga lenei a le Alii, ia fausia le aai o Ierusalema Fou i le faapotopotoina o le au paia, e amata atu i le nofoaga lenei, le nofoaga lea o le malumalu, le malumalu lea o le a faatuina i le tupulaga lenei.

verses.en: For verily this generation shall not all pass away until an house shall be built unto the Lord, and a cloud shall rest upon it, which cloud shall be even the glory of the Lord, which shall fill the house.
verses.sm: Auā e moni e lē mavae uma atu le tupulaga lenei seia fausia se maota mo le Alii, ma o le a faamalumalu ai se ao i ona luga, le ao lea o le mamalu lava o le Alii, lea o le a faatumulia ai le maota.

verses.en: And the sons of Moses, according to the Holy Priesthood which he received under the hand of his father-in-law, Jethro;
verses.sm: Ma atalii o Mose, e tusa ma le Perisitua Paia na ia maua i lalo o le lima o Ietero le tamā-o-lana-avā.

verses.en: And Jethro received it under the hand of Caleb;
verses.sm: Ma na maua e Ietero i lalo o le lima o Kalepo;

verses.en: And Caleb received it under the hand of Elihu;
verses.sm: Ma na maua e Kalepo i lalo o le lima o Eliu;

verses.en: And Elihu under the hand of Jeremy;
verses.sm: Ma na maua e Eliu i lalo o le lima o Ieremai;

verses.en: And Jeremy under the hand of Gad;
verses.sm: Ma Ieremai i lalo o le lima o Kato;

verses.en: And Gad under the hand of Esaias;
verses.sm: Ma Kato i lalo o le lima o Esaia;

verses.en: And Esaias received it under the hand of God.
verses.sm: Ma na maua e Esaia i lalo o le aao o le Atua.

verses.en: Esaias also lived in the days of Abraham, and was blessed of him—
verses.sm: Na ola foi Esaia i aso o Aperaamo, ma sa faamanuiaina e ia—

verses.en: Which Abraham received the priesthood from Melchizedek, who received it through the lineage of his fathers, even till Noah;
verses.sm: O Aperaamo lea na ia maua le perisitua mai ia Mekisateko, o lē na mauaina le perisitua e ala i le gafa o ona tamā, seia oo lava ia Noa;

verses.en: And from Noah till Enoch, through the lineage of their fathers;
verses.sm: Ma mai ia Noa seia oo ia Enoka, e ala i le gafa o o la’ua tamā;

verses.en: And from Enoch to Abel, who was slain by the conspiracy of his brother, who received the priesthood by the commandments of God, by the hand of his father Adam, who was the first man—
verses.sm: Ma mai ia Enoka ia Apelu, o lē na fasiotia i le taupulepulega faalilolilo a lona uso, o lē na mauaina le perisitua i poloaiga a le Atua, i le lima o lona tamā, o Atamu, o lē o le uluai tagata—

verses.en: Which priesthood continueth in the church of God in all generations, and is without beginning of days or end of years.
verses.sm: O le perisitua lea sa i ai pea i le ekalesia a le Atua i tupulaga uma, ma ua aunoa ma se amataga o aso po o se iuga o tausaga.

verses.en: And the Lord confirmed a priesthood also upon Aaron and his seed, throughout all their generations, which priesthood also continueth and abideth forever with the priesthood which is after the holiest order of God.
verses.sm: Ma sa faamau foi e le Alii se perisitua i luga o Arona ma ana fanau, i a latou tupulaga uma, le perisitua lea ua i ai pea lava foi ma tumau e faavavau faatasi ma le perisitua lea ua tusa ma le faatulagaga sili ona paia a le Atua.

verses.en: And this greater priesthood administereth the gospel and holdeth the key of the mysteries of the kingdom, even the key of the knowledge of God.
verses.sm: Ma o le perisitua tele lea e pulea le talalelei ma umia le ki o mealilo o le malo, o le ki lava lea o le malamalama e uiga i le Atua.

verses.en: Therefore, in the ordinances thereof, the power of godliness is manifest.
verses.sm: O lea, o ona sauniga, ua faaalia ai le mana o le faale-atua.

verses.en: And without the ordinances thereof, and the authority of the priesthood, the power of godliness is not manifest unto men in the flesh;
verses.sm: Ma a aunoa ma ona sauniga, ma le pule o le perisitua, e lē faaalia mai le mana o le faale-atua i tagata i la le tino;

verses.en: For without this no man can see the face of God, even the Father, and live.
verses.sm: Auā a aunoa ma lea, e leai se tagata e mafai ona vaai i fofoga o le Atua, le Tamā lava, ma ola.

verses.en: Now this Moses plainly taught to the children of Israel in the wilderness, and sought diligently to sanctify his people that they might behold the face of God;
verses.sm: O lenei, o lenei mea sa aoao manino atu e Mose i le fanauga a Isaraelu i le vao, ma saili ma le filiga e faapaia lona nuu ina ia mafai ona latou vaai i fofoga o le Atua;

verses.en: But they hardened their hearts and could not endure his presence; therefore, the Lord in his wrath, for his anger was kindled against them, swore that they should not enter into his rest while in the wilderness, which rest is the fulness of his glory.
verses.sm: Peitai sa latou faamaaa o latou loto ma lē mafai ai ona latou tumau i ona luma; o lea, o le Alii i lona toasa, ona sa sasao a’e lona toatamai e faasaga ia te i latou, na tauto ai e lē tatau ona latou ulu atu i lona malologa, o le malologa lea o le atoatoaga o lona mamalu, a’o latou i ai i le vao.

verses.en: Therefore, he took Moses out of their midst, and the Holy Priesthood also;
verses.sm: O lea, na ave ai e ia Mose i fafo mai totonu o i latou, ma le Perisitua Paia foi;

verses.en: And the lesser priesthood continued, which priesthood holdeth the key of the ministering of angels and the preparatory gospel;
verses.sm: Ae sa i ai pea le perisitua maualalo, le perisitua lea ua umia le ki o le ’auaunaga a agelu ma le talalelei sauniuni;

verses.en: Which gospel is the gospel of repentance and of baptism, and the remission of sins, and the law of carnal commandments, which the Lord in his wrath caused to continue with the house of Aaron among the children of Israel until John, whom God raised up, being filled with the Holy Ghost from his mother’s womb.
verses.sm: O le talalelei lea o le talalelei o le salamo ma le papatisoga, ma le faamagaloina o agasala, ma le tulafono o poloaiga faaletino, ia na faia e le Alii i lona toasa ia tumau pea i le aiga o Arona i totonu o le fanauga a Isaraelu seia oo mai ia Ioane, o lē na saunia e le Atua, ua faatumuina i le Agaga Paia mai le manava o lona tinā.

verses.en: For he was baptized while he was yet in his childhood, and was ordained by the angel of God at the time he was eight days old unto this power, to overthrow the kingdom of the Jews, and to make straight the way of the Lord before the face of his people, to prepare them for the coming of the Lord, in whose hand is given all power.
verses.sm: Auā sa papatisoina o ia a’o i ai lava o ia i lona tamaitiiti, ma sa faauuina e le agelu a le Atua i lenei mana i le taimi na valu ai aso o lona matua, e faatoilalo le malo o Iutaia, ma fai faasa’osa’o le ala o le Alii i luma o mata o lona nuu, e saunia ai i latou mo le afio mai o le Alii, o lē ua tuu atu i ona lima le mana uma.

verses.en: And again, the offices of elder and bishop are necessary appendages belonging unto the high priesthood.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o tofi o le toeaina ma le epikopo, o ni faaopoopoga tatau ai i le perisitua maualuga.

verses.en: And again, the offices of teacher and deacon are necessary appendages belonging to the lesser priesthood, which priesthood was confirmed upon Aaron and his sons.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o tofi o le a’oa’o ma le tiakono, o ni faaopoopoga tatau e a le perisitua maualalo, o le perisitua lea na faamauina i luga o Arona ma ona atalii.

verses.en: Therefore, as I said concerning the sons of Moses—for the sons of Moses and also the sons of Aaron shall offer an acceptable offering and sacrifice in the house of the Lord, which house shall be built unto the Lord in this generation, upon the consecrated spot as I have appointed—
verses.sm: O lea, e pei ona Ou fai atu e uiga i atalii o Mose— ona o atalii o Mose ma atalii foi o Arona o le a osia se taulaga mu ma se taulaga e taliaina i le maota o le Alii, le maota lea o le a fausia mo le Alii i le tupulaga lenei, i luga o le fasifanua faapaiaina e pei ona Ou tofia—

verses.en: And the sons of Moses and of Aaron shall be filled with the glory of the Lord, upon Mount Zion in the Lord’s house, whose sons are ye; and also many whom I have called and sent forth to build up my church.
verses.sm: Ma o atalii o Mose ma Arona o le a faatumulia i le mamalu o le Alii i luga o le Mauga o Siona, i le maota o le Alii, o e o o la’ua atalii o outou ia; ma le toatele foi o e ua ou valaaulia ma auina atu e atia’e la’u ekalesia.

verses.en: For whoso is faithful unto the obtaining these two priesthoods of which I have spoken, and the magnifying their calling, are sanctified by the Spirit unto the renewing of their bodies.
verses.sm: Auā ’ai se tasi e faamaoni i le mauaina o ia perisitua e lua ua Ou tautala atu ai, ma le faalauteleina o o latou valaauga, e faapaiaina e le Agaga i le faafouina o o latou tino.

verses.en: They become the sons of Moses and of Aaron and the seed of Abraham, and the church and kingdom, and the elect of God.
verses.sm: E avea i latou ma atalii o Mose ma Arona ma fanau a Aperaamo, ma le ekalesia ma le malo, ma le ’au filifilia a le Atua.

verses.en: And also all they who receive this priesthood receive me, saith the Lord;
verses.sm: O lenei foi o i latou uma o e e talia lenei perisitua ua latou talia a’u, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii;

verses.en: For he that receiveth my servants receiveth me;
verses.sm: Auā o ia o lē e talia a’u auauna ua ia talia a’u;

verses.en: And he that receiveth me receiveth my Father;
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e talia a’u ua ia talia lo’u Tamā;

verses.en: And he that receiveth my Father receiveth my Father’s kingdom; therefore all that my Father hath shall be given unto him.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e talia lo’u Tamā e maua e ia le malo o lo’u Tamā; o lea, o mea uma ua i ai i lo’u Tamā o le a tuu atu ia te ia.

verses.en: And this is according to the oath and covenant which belongeth to the priesthood.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei mea ua tusa ai ma le tautoga ma le feagaiga e a le perisitua ia.

verses.en: Therefore, all those who receive the priesthood, receive this oath and covenant of my Father, which he cannot break, neither can it be moved.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o i latou uma o e e mauaina le perisitua, e mauaina lenei tautoga ma le feagaiga a lo’u Tamā, e lē mafai ona solia e ia, pe mafai ona aveesea.

verses.en: But whoso breaketh this covenant after he hath received it, and altogether turneth therefrom, shall not have forgiveness of sins in this world nor in the world to come.
verses.sm: Peitai ’ai se e solia lenei feagaiga ina ua uma ona maua e ia, ma liliu ese atoa mai ai, o le a lē maua e ia se faamagaloga o agasala i le lalolagi lenei po o le lalolagi a sau.

verses.en: And wo unto all those who come not unto this priesthood which ye have received, which I now confirm upon you who are present this day, by mine own voice out of the heavens; and even I have given the heavenly hosts and mine angels charge concerning you.
verses.sm: Ma oi talofa ia te i latou uma o e e lē o mai i lenei perisitua ua outou maua, lea ua Ou faamauina nei i luga o outou o e ua auai i lenei aso, i lo’u lava leo mai le lagi; ma ua ’Ou tuu atu foi i ’au o le lagi ma a’u agelu le tiute e faatatau ia te outou.

verses.en: And I now give unto you a commandment to beware concerning yourselves, to give diligent heed to the words of eternal life.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu nei ia te outou se poloaiga ia outou faaeteete e faatatau ia te outou lava, ia outou gaua’i ma le filiga i upu o le ola e faavavau.

verses.en: For you shall live by every word that proceedeth forth from the mouth of God.
verses.sm: Ona ia outou ola i afioga uma e tulei mai le fofoga o le Atua.

verses.en: For the word of the Lord is truth, and whatsoever is truth is light, and whatsoever is light is Spirit, even the Spirit of Jesus Christ.
verses.sm: Auā o le afioga a le Alii o le upumoni lea, ma o soo se mea ua moni, o le malamalama lea, ma o soo se mea ua malamalama, o le Agaga lea, o le Agaga lava lea o Iesu Keriso.

verses.en: And the Spirit giveth light to every man that cometh into the world; and the Spirit enlighteneth every man through the world, that hearkeneth to the voice of the Spirit.
verses.sm: Ma o le Agaga na te tuuina mai le malamalama i tagata taitoatasi e sau i le lalolagi; ma o le Agaga e faamalamalamaina tagata taitoatasi i le lalolagi atoa, o e e faalogo i le siufofoga o le Agaga.

verses.en: And every one that hearkeneth to the voice of the Spirit cometh unto God, even the Father.
verses.sm: Ma o tagata uma taitoatasi o e e faalogo i le siufofoga o le Agaga, e o mai i le Atua, le Tamā lava.

verses.en: And the Father teacheth him of the covenant which he has renewed and confirmed upon you, which is confirmed upon you for your sakes, and not for your sakes only, but for the sake of the whole world.
verses.sm: Ma e a’oa’o o ia e le Tamā e uiga i le feagaiga ua faafouina ma faamauina e ia i luga o outou, lea ua faamauina i luga o outou i le manatu ia te outou, ma ua lē mo na’o outou, ae mo le lalolagi atoa.

verses.en: And the whole world lieth in sin, and groaneth under darkness and under the bondage of sin.
verses.sm: Ma ua taoto le lalolagi atoa i le agasala, ma ua ōi i lalo o le pouliuli ma lalo o le pologa o le agasala.

verses.en: And by this you may know they are under the bondage of sin, because they come not unto me.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei mea o le a mafai ona outou iloa ai ua i ai i latou i lalo o le pologa o le agasala, ona ua latou lē o mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: For whoso cometh not unto me is under the bondage of sin.
verses.sm: Auā ’ai se tasi e lē sau ia te a’u, ua i ai i lalo o le pologa o le agasala.

verses.en: And whoso receiveth not my voice is not acquainted with my voice, and is not of me.
verses.sm: Ma ’ai se tasi e lē taliaina lo’u leo, ua lē masani i lo’u leo, ma ua lē a a’u ia.

verses.en: And by this you may know the righteous from the wicked, and that the whole world groaneth under sin and darkness even now.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei mea o le a mafai ai ona outou iloa o le amiotonu mai le amioleaga, ma ua ōi le lalolagi atoa i lalo o le agasala ma le pouliuli i le taimi nei lava.

verses.en: And your minds in times past have been darkened because of unbelief, and because you have treated lightly the things you have received—
verses.sm: Ma sa faapouliuligia o outou mafaufau i taimi ua mavae ona o le lē talitonu, ma ona sa outou manatu māmā i mea ua outou maua—

verses.en: Which vanity and unbelief have brought the whole church under condemnation.
verses.sm: O le faafiasili lea ma le lē talitonu ua aumai ai le ekalesia atoa i lalo o le tausalaga.

verses.en: And this condemnation resteth upon the children of Zion, even all.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ta’usalaga ua tauaveina i luga o le fanauga a Siona, i latou uma lava.

verses.en: And they shall remain under this condemnation until they repent and remember the new covenant, even the Book of Mormon and the former commandments which I have given them, not only to say, but to do according to that which I have written—
verses.sm: Ma o le a latou tumau pea i lalo o lenei ta’usalaga, seia latou salamo ma manatua le feagaiga fou, o le Tusi a Mamona lava lea ma poloaiga muamua ia na Ou tuuina atu ia te i latou, ia lē na’o le fai atu, ae ia faia e tusa ai ma mea ua Ou tusia—

verses.en: That they may bring forth fruit meet for their Father’s kingdom; otherwise there remaineth a scourge and judgment to be poured out upon the children of Zion.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona latou aumai o ni fua e tatau ai mo le malo o lo latou Tamā; a lē o lea o le a tumau pea le sasa ma le faamasinoga e liligi mai i luga o le fanauga a Siona.

verses.en: For shall the children of the kingdom pollute my holy land? Verily, I say unto you, Nay.
verses.sm: Auā pe faaeleelea ea e fanau o le malo lo’u laueleele paia? E moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e Leai.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you who now hear my words, which are my voice, blessed are ye inasmuch as you receive these things;
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou o e o faalogo mai nei i a’u upu, o lo’u leo lea, amuia outou e tusa ai ma lo outou taliaina o nei mea;

verses.en: For I will forgive you of your sins with this commandment—that you remain steadfast in your minds in solemnity and the spirit of prayer, in bearing testimony to all the world of those things which are communicated unto you.
verses.sm: Auā o le a Ou faamagaloina outou ia outou agasala e ala i le poloaiga lenei— ia outou tutumau-mausalī i o outou mafaufau i le mamalu ma le agaga o le tatalo, i le tuuina atu o le molimau i le lalolagi atoa e uiga i mea ia ua ta’u atu ia te outou.

verses.en: Therefore, go ye into all the world; and unto whatsoever place ye cannot go ye shall send, that the testimony may go from you into all the world unto every creature.
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou o atu i le lalolagi atoa; ma i soo se mea e lē mafai ona outou o atu i ai, ia outou auina atu i ai, ina ia mafai ona alu atu o le molimau mai ia te outou i le lalolagi atoa i tagata uma.

verses.en: And as I said unto mine apostles, even so I say unto you, for you are mine apostles, even God’s high priests; ye are they whom my Father hath given me; ye are my friends;
verses.sm: Ma e pei ona sa Ou fai atu i a’u aposetolo, e faapea lava ona Ou fai atu ia te outou, ona o outou o a’u aposetolo, o faitaulaga sili lava a le Atua; o outou ia o i latou o e na tuuina mai e lo’u Tamā ia te a’u; o outou o a’u uo;

verses.en: Therefore, as I said unto mine apostles I say unto you again, that every soul who believeth on your words, and is baptized by water for the remission of sins, shall receive the Holy Ghost.
verses.sm: O lea, e pei ona Ou fai atu i a’u aposetolo Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, o tagata uma taitoatasi o e e talitonu ia outou upu, ma papatiso i le vai mo le faamagaloina o agasala, o le a mauaina le Agaga Paia.

verses.en: And these signs shall follow them that believe—
verses.sm: Ma o faailoga nei e mulimuli ia te i latou o e e talitonu—

verses.en: In my name they shall do many wonderful works;
verses.sm: O lo’u igoa o le a latou faia ai galuega ofoofogia e tele;

verses.en: In my name they shall cast out devils;
verses.sm: O lo’u igoa o le a latou tutuli ese ai tiapolo;

verses.en: In my name they shall heal the sick;
verses.sm: O lo’u igoa o le a latou faamalolo ai e mama’i;

verses.en: In my name they shall open the eyes of the blind, and unstop the ears of the deaf;
verses.sm: O lo’u igoa o le a latou faapupula ai mata o e tauaso, ma tatala ai taliga o e tutuli;

verses.en: And the tongue of the dumb shall speak;
verses.sm: Ma o le a faatautatala ai laulaufaiva o e ua gūgū;

verses.en: And if any man shall administer poison unto them it shall not hurt them;
verses.sm: Ma afai e tuu atu e se tagata ia te i latou se mea ’oona o le a lē afaina ai i latou;

verses.en: And the poison of a serpent shall not have power to harm them.
verses.sm: Ma o le a leai se malosi o le ’ona o se gata e afaina ai i latou.

verses.en: But a commandment I give unto them, that they shall not boast themselves of these things, neither speak them before the world; for these things are given unto you for your profit and for salvation.
verses.sm: Ae Ou te tuu atu ia te i latou se poloaiga, ia aua ne’i mitamitavale i latou lava i nei mea, pe tautala atu ai i luma o le lalolagi; auā o nei mea ua tuuina atu ia te outou mo lo outou manuia ma lo outou faaolataga.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, they who believe not on your words, and are not baptized in water in my name, for the remission of their sins, that they may receive the Holy Ghost, shall be damned, and shall not come into my Father’s kingdom where my Father and I am.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o i latou o e e lē talitonu ia outou upu, ma lē papatisoina i le vai i lo’u igoa, mo le faamagaloina o a latou agasala, ina ia mafai ona latou maua o le Agaga Paia, o le a ta’usalaina, ma o le a lē o mai i le malo o lo’u Tamā, i le mea o i ai lo’u Tamā ma A’u.

verses.en: And this revelation unto you, and commandment, is in force from this very hour upon all the world, and the gospel is unto all who have not received it.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faaaliga, ma le poloaiga, ia te outou, ua faamamaluina nei mai lenei lava itula i luga o le lalolagi atoa, ma ua i ai le talalelei ia oo atu i tagata uma o e latou te le’i mauaina.

verses.en: But, verily I say unto all those to whom the kingdom has been given—from you it must be preached unto them, that they shall repent of their former evil works; for they are to be upbraided for their evil hearts of unbelief, and your brethren in Zion for their rebellion against you at the time I sent you.
verses.sm: Peitai, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te i latou uma o e ua tuuina atu i ai le malo— e ao ina tala’i atu mai ia te outou ia te i latou, ina ia latou salamo ia latou galuega leaga muamua; aua e tatau ona a’oa’iina i latou i o latou loto leaga o le lē talitonu, ma o outou uso i Siona ona o lo latou fouvale faasaga mai ia te outou i le taimi na Ou auina atu ai outou.

verses.en: And again I say unto you, my friends, for from henceforth I shall call you friends, it is expedient that I give unto you this commandment, that ye become even as my friends in days when I was with them, traveling to preach the gospel in my power;
verses.sm: Ma Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, a’u uo e, auā o le a amata atu nei ma le agai i luma ona Ou ta’ua outou o uo, ua tatau ai ona Ou tuu atu ia te outou le poloaiga lenei, ia avea outou ma a’u uo e pei lava i aso na Ou faatasi ai ma i latou, i le malaga atu e tala’i atu le talalelei i lo’u mana;

verses.en: For I suffered them not to have purse or scrip, neither two coats.
verses.sm: Auā sa Ou lē tuuina atu ia te i latou ia i ai ni a latou atotupe po o ni ato malaga, po o ni peleue se lua.

verses.en: Behold, I send you out to prove the world, and the laborer is worthy of his hire.
verses.sm: Faauta, Ou te auina atu outou e tofotofo le lalolagi, ma e agavaa lē e galue i lona taui.

verses.en: And any man that shall go and preach this gospel of the kingdom, and fail not to continue faithful in all things, shall not be weary in mind, neither darkened, neither in body, limb, nor joint; and a hair of his head shall not fall to the ground unnoticed. And they shall not go hungry, neither athirst.
verses.sm: Ma o soo se tagata e alu atu ma tala’i atu lenei talalelei o le malo, ma lē vaivai e tumau pea i le faamaoni i mea uma, o le a lē vaivai i le mafaufau, pe faapouliuligia, pe i le tino, itutino, po o soogaivi; ma o le a lē pa’ū se lauulu o lona ulu i le eleele e aunoa ma le lē iloa. Ma o le a latou lē fia aai, pe fia feinu.

verses.en: Therefore, take ye no thought for the morrow, for what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, or wherewithal ye shall be clothed.
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou lē mafaufau mo a taeao, mo mea o le a outou ’ai, po o mea o le a outou inu, po o mea o le a outou oofu ai.

verses.en: For, consider the lilies of the field, how they grow, they toil not, neither do they spin; and the kingdoms of the world, in all their glory, are not arrayed like one of these.
verses.sm: Auā, ia mafaufau i lili o le fanua, i le ala ua latou tutupu a’e ai, latou te lē galulue, pe latou te milo foi; ae o malo o le lalolagi, i o latou mamalu atoa, ua lē faala’eiina e pei o se tasi o i latou nei.

verses.en: For your Father, who is in heaven, knoweth that you have need of all these things.
verses.sm: Auā o lo outou Tamā, o lē o i le lagi, ua silafia e ia ua outou manaomia nei mea uma.

verses.en: Therefore, let the morrow take thought for the things of itself.
verses.sm: O lea, ia tuu taeao e manatu i ona lava mea.

verses.en: Neither take ye thought beforehand what ye shall say; but treasure up in your minds continually the words of life, and it shall be given you in the very hour that portion that shall be meted unto every man.
verses.sm: Pe tou te mafaufau muamua foi po o a tou te fai atu ai; ae ia teu i o outou mafaufau e lē aunoa afioga o le ola, ma o le a tuuina atu ia te outou i lea lava itula le vaega lena o le a fuaina atu i tagata taitoatasi.

verses.en: Therefore, let no man among you, for this commandment is unto all the faithful who are called of God in the church unto the ministry, from this hour take purse or scrip, that goeth forth to proclaim this gospel of the kingdom.
verses.sm: O lea, ia lē tuu atu i se tagata e i totonu o outou, ona o le poloaiga lenei ua mo tagata faamaoni uma o e ua valaaulia e le Atua i le ekalesia mo le auaunaga, e o atu e folafola atu le talalelei lenei o le malo, e ave, mai le itula lenei, se atotupe po o se ato malaga.

verses.en: Behold, I send you out to reprove the world of all their unrighteous deeds, and to teach them of a judgment which is to come.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua Ou auina atu outou e a’oa’i le lalolagi i a latou galuega amioletonu uma, ma a’oa’o atu ia te i latou e uiga i se faamasinoga o le a oo mai.

verses.en: And whoso receiveth you, there I will be also, for I will go before your face. I will be on your right hand and on your left, and my Spirit shall be in your hearts, and mine angels round about you, to bear you up.
verses.sm: Ma ai se na te talia outou, o iina o le a Ou i ai foi, ona o le a Ou alu muamua atu i o outou luma. O le a Ou i ai i lo outou lima taumatau ma lo outou agavale, ma o le a i ai lo’u Agaga i o outou loto, ma si’o faataamilo outou e a’u agelu, e sapasapai outou i luga.

verses.en: Whoso receiveth you receiveth me; and the same will feed you, and clothe you, and give you money.
verses.sm: Ai se na te talia outou ua ia talia a’u; ma o ia lava lea o le a fafagaina outou, ma faalavalava outou, ma avatu tupe ia te outou.

verses.en: And he who feeds you, or clothes you, or gives you money, shall in nowise lose his reward.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e fafaga ia te outou, pe faalavalava outou, pe avatu ia te outou tupe, o le a leai se ala o le a lē maua ai lona taui.

verses.en: And he that doeth not these things is not my disciple; by this you may know my disciples.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē na te lē faia ia mea ua lē o so’u soo o ia; o le mea lenei e mafai ona outou iloa ai o’u soo.

verses.en: He that receiveth you not, go away from him alone by yourselves, and cleanse your feet even with water, pure water, whether in heat or in cold, and bear testimony of it unto your Father which is in heaven, and return not again unto that man.
verses.sm: O ia o lē na te lē talia outou, o ese mai ia te ia na’o outou lava, ma mulumulu o outou vae i vai, vai mamā ia, pe vevela pe malulu, ma molimau atu lena mea i lo outou Tamā o i le lagi, ma ia outou lē toe foi atu i lena tagata.

verses.en: And in whatsoever village or city ye enter, do likewise.
verses.sm: Ma i soo se nuu po o se aai tou te ulu atu i ai, ia faapena lava ona outou faia.

verses.en: Nevertheless, search diligently and spare not; and wo unto that house, or that village or city that rejecteth you, or your words, or your testimony concerning me.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, ia outou saili ma le filigā ma ia lē taofia; ma oi talofa i lena fale, po o lena nuu po o le aai e teena outou, po o a outou upu, po o a outou molimau e uiga ia te a’u.

verses.en: Wo, I say again, unto that house, or that village or city that rejecteth you, or your words, or your testimony of me;
verses.sm: Ou te toe fai atu, oi talofa i lena fale, po o lena nuu po o lena aai e teena outou, po o a outou upu, po o a outou molimau e uiga ia te a’u;

verses.en: For I, the Almighty, have laid my hands upon the nations, to scourge them for their wickedness.
verses.sm: Aua o A’u, o lē Malosi Aoao, ua faaee atu o’u lima i luga o atunuu e sasa ia te i latou ona o a latou amioleaga.

verses.en: And plagues shall go forth, and they shall not be taken from the earth until I have completed my work, which shall be cut short in righteousness—
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo atu mala ma o le a lē aveeseina ia mala mai le lalolagi se’ia uma la’u galuega, lea o le a faapuupuuina i le amiotonu—

verses.en: Until all shall know me, who remain, even from the least unto the greatest, and shall be filled with the knowledge of the Lord, and shall see eye to eye, and shall lift up their voice, and with the voice together sing this new song, saying:
verses.sm: Se’ia oo ina iloa A’u e tagata uma, o e e totoe, mai lava i lē ua aupito itiiti e oo atu i lē aupito sili, ma o le a faatumulia i le malamalama o le Alii, ma o le a vaai mata i le mata, ma o le a siitia a’e o latou leo, ma o le a latou pepese faatasi ma le leo le pese fou lenei, fai mai:

verses.en: The Lord hath brought again Zion;The Lord hath redeemed his people, Israel,According to the election of grace,Which was brought to pass by the faithAnd covenant of their fathers.
verses.sm: Ua toe aumai e le Alii Siona; Ua togiolaina e le Alii lona nuu, o Isaraelu,E tusa ma le filifiliga o le alofa tunoa,Lea na faataunuuina i le faatuatuaMa le feagaiga a o latou tamā.

verses.en: The Lord hath redeemed his people;And Satan is bound and time is no longer.The Lord hath gathered all things in one.The Lord hath brought down Zion from above.The Lord hath brought up Zion from beneath.
verses.sm: Ua togiola e le Alii lona nuu; Ma ua noatia Satani ma ua lē toe i ai se taimi.Ua faapotopoto e le Alii mea uma i le tasi.Ua aumai Siona e le Aliii lalo mai lugā.Ua ava’e i luga Siona e le Alii mai lalō.

verses.en: The earth hath travailed and brought forth her strength;And truth is established in her bowels;And the heavens have smiled upon her;And she is clothed with the glory of her God;For he stands in the midst of his people.
verses.sm: Ua mapuitiga le lalolagi ma ua aumai lona malosi; Ma ua faatuina le upumoni i lona loto; Ma ua fiafia mai le lagi i ona luga; Ma ua faaofuina o ia i le mamalu o lona Atua; Ona ua tulai o ia i totonu o ona tagata.

verses.en: Glory, and honor, and power, and might,Be ascribed to our God; for he is full of mercy,Justice, grace and truth, and peace,Forever and ever, Amen.
verses.sm: O le mamalu, ma le viiga, ma le mana, ma le malosi,Ia tuu atu i lo tatou Atua; ona ua tumu o ia i le alofa mutimutivale,Amiotonu, alofa tunoa ma le faamaoni, ma le filemu,E faavavau, faavavau lava, Amene.

verses.en: And again, verily, verily, I say unto you, it is expedient that every man who goes forth to proclaim mine everlasting gospel, that inasmuch as they have families, and receive money by gift, that they should send it unto them or make use of it for their benefit, as the Lord shall direct them, for thus it seemeth me good.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e tatau i tagata taitoatasi o e e o atu e folafola atu la’u talalelei tumau e faavavau, e tusa ai ma le ia i o ni o latou aiga, ma latou maua ni tupe e ala i meaalofa, e tatau ona latou auina atu ia tupe ia te i latou pe faaaoga mo lo latou lelei, e pei ona faatonuina ai i latou e le Alii, ona ua faapea ona foliga lelei lena mea ia te a’u.

verses.en: And let all those who have not families, who receive money, send it up unto the bishop in Zion, or unto the bishop in Ohio, that it may be consecrated for the bringing forth of the revelations and the printing thereof, and for establishing Zion.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu ia te i latou uma o e ua leai ni aiga, o e e maua tupe, e auina atu ia tupe i le epikopo i Siona, po o le epikopo i Ohaio, ina ia faapaiaina mo le aumaia o faaaliga ma lo latou lomiga, ma mo le faatuina o Siona.

verses.en: And if any man shall give unto any of you a coat, or a suit, take the old and cast it unto the poor, and go on your way rejoicing.
verses.sm: Ma afai e tuu atu e se tagata i soo se tasi o outou se peleue, po o se suti, ia ave ofu tuai ma tuu atu i e matitiva, ma o i o outou ala ma le olioli.

verses.en: And if any man among you be strong in the Spirit, let him take with him him that is weak, that he may be edified in all meekness, that he may become strong also.
verses.sm: Ma afai e i ai se tagata i totonu o outou ua malosi i le Agaga, ia tuu atu ia te ia na te ave faatasi ma ia lē ua vaivai, ina ia faagaeetiaina o ia i le agamalu atoa, ina ia faamalosia foi o ia.

verses.en: Therefore, take with you those who are ordained unto the lesser priesthood, and send them before you to make appointments, and to prepare the way, and to fill appointments that you yourselves are not able to fill.
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou ave faatasi ma outou e ua faauuina i le perisitua maualalo, ma auina atu i latou e muamua atu ia te outou e fai tuutuuga, ma saunia le ala, ma faataunuu tuutuuga ua lē mafai e outou lava ona faataunuu.

verses.en: Behold, this is the way that mine apostles, in ancient days, built up my church unto me.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le ala lenei na ati a’e ai e a’u aposetolo, i aso anamua, la’u ekalesia ia te a’u.

verses.en: Therefore, let every man stand in his own office, and labor in his own calling; and let not the head say unto the feet it hath no need of the feet; for without the feet how shall the body be able to stand?
verses.sm: O lea, ia tuu atu i tagata taitoatasi ia tu i lona lava tofi, ma galue i lona lava valaaulia, ma ia lē tuu atu i le ulu e fai atu i vae ua lē manaomia e ia vae; aua a aunoa ma vae o le a mafai faapefea e le tino ona tu?

verses.en: Also the body hath need of every member, that all may be edified together, that the system may be kept perfect.
verses.sm: E faapea foi le manaomia e le tino ia itutino taitasi uma, ina ia mafai ona faagaeetia uma faatasi, ina ia mafai ona tausi i le atoatoa le faatulagaga.

verses.en: And behold, the high priests should travel, and also the elders, and also the lesser priests; but the deacons and teachers should be appointed to watch over the church, to be standing ministers unto the church.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, e tatau i faitaulaga sili ona malaga, ma toeaina foi, ma ositaulaga maualalo foi; ae o tiakono ma a’oa’o e tatau ona tofia e leoleo i luga o le ekalesia, e avea ma auauna nonofo mau mo le ekalesia.

verses.en: And the bishop, Newel K. Whitney, also should travel round about and among all the churches, searching after the poor to administer to their wants by humbling the rich and the proud.
verses.sm: Ma e tatau foi i le epikopo, o Newel K. Whitney, ona malaga faataamilo ma i totonu o aulotu uma, e saili e matitiva e fesoasoani i o latou manaoga i le faalotomaualaloina o e mau’oa ma e faamaualuluga.

verses.en: He should also employ an agent to take charge and to do his secular business as he shall direct.
verses.sm: E tatau foi ia te ia ona fai sona sui e galue totogi e pulea ma faia lana pisinisi faaletino e pei ona o le a faatonu ai e ia.

verses.en: Nevertheless, let the bishop go unto the city of New York, also to the city of Albany, and also to the city of Boston, and warn the people of those cities with the sound of the gospel, with a loud voice, of the desolation and utter abolishment which await them if they do reject these things.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, ia tuu atu i le epikopo e alu i le aai o Niu Ioka, ma i le aai foi o Albany, ma i le aai foi o Boston, ma lapatai atu i tagata o aai na i le leo o le talalelei, ma se leo tele, e uiga i le faatafunaga ma le faafanoga atoa ua faatalitali mai ia te i latou pe afai latou te teena nei mea.

verses.en: For if they do reject these things the hour of their judgment is nigh, and their house shall be left unto them desolate.
verses.sm: Auā afai latou te teena nei mea, ua lata mai lava le itula o lo latou faamasinoga, ma o lo latou fale o le a tuua tuufua ia te i latou.

verses.en: Let him trust in me and he shall not be confounded; and a hair of his head shall not fall to the ground unnoticed.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu ia te ia e faalagolago mai ia te a’u ma o le a lē faafememea’iina ai o ia; ma o le a lē pa’ū se lauulu o lona ao i le eleele e aunoa ma le iloa.

verses.en: And verily I say unto you, the rest of my servants, go ye forth as your circumstances shall permit, in your several callings, unto the great and notable cities and villages, reproving the world in righteousness of all their unrighteous and ungodly deeds, setting forth clearly and understandingly the desolation of abomination in the last days.
verses.sm: Ma e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, a’u auauna o totoe, ia outou o atu pe a mafai ai e tusa ma tulaga ua outou i ai, i o outou valaauga eseese, i aai ma nuu tetele ma ta’uta’ua, ma a’oa’i i le amiotonu le lalolagi e uiga ia latou amioletonu ma galuega uma e lē faale-atua, ma faamatala manino atu ma le malamalama lelei le faatafunaga o mea inosia i aso e gata ai.

verses.en: For, with you saith the Lord Almighty, I will rend their kingdoms; I will not only shake the earth, but the starry heavens shall tremble.
verses.sm: Auā, o le a ala atu ia te outou, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii Malosi Aoao, ona Ou saeia o latou malo; o le a lē gata ina Ou luluina le lalolagi, ae o le a gatete le lagi ua tumu i fetu.

verses.en: For I, the Lord, have put forth my hand to exert the powers of heaven; ye cannot see it now, yet a little while and ye shall see it, and know that I am, and that I will come and reign with my people.
verses.sm: Auā o A’u, o le Alii, ua tuu atu lo’u lima e faagaoioi mana o le lagi; e lē mafai ona outou vaai nei i ai, ae ua toeitiiti ona outou vaai lea i ai, ma iloa ai ua Ou i ai, ma o le a Ou alu atu ma nonofotupu faatasi ma lo’u nuu.

verses.en: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. Amen.
verses.sm: O A’u o le Alefa ma le Omeka, o le amataga ma le gataaga. Amene.
